entries.description: Better-quality option contracts every trading night, and the history to plan the exit, for AI agents: a liquidity-ranked bullish pool, point-in-time features, the exit lab (opportunity surfaces, touch probabilities, bracket scoring), contract replay, and methodology playbooks. Your agent builds the trade plan with you. There is no pick endpoint. Educational only. Not investment advice.
